subject: Webhook failure HTTP 504 Gateway Timeout during webhook push
incomingEmail:
Hello Technical Support,

Our webhook listener service is receiving HTTP 504 Gateway Timeout errors when your platform pushes event payloads for `order.completed` events. We noticed this started happening when payloads exceeded 5MB.

What is the payload size limit and timeout threshold for outbound webhooks?

Regards,
Alex Rivera
Senior Tech Lead @ E-Com Platform
expertReferenceReply:
Hi Alex,

Thank you for bringing this to our attention.

Our platform enforces an outbound HTTP request timeout of 10 seconds and a maximum webhook payload limit of 2MB per event dispatch. If your endpoint takes longer than 10 seconds to respond or if the payload exceeds 2MB, our gateway drops the connection and returns a 504 Gateway Timeout.

To resolve this:
1. Configure event filtering in your Webhook settings to omit large nested object graphs.
2. Ensure your webhook endpoint acknowledges the event with an immediate HTTP 200 OK before kicking off asynchronous processing.

Please let us know if you need assistance trimming the payload fields!

Best regards,
Developer Relations Team

adversarialReplies.offTopic:
Hi Alex,

Thank you for reaching out about your billing account. We offer several enterprise pricing plans that include higher storage and server capacity. Please let us know if you would like a sales quote for upgrading your plan.

Best regards,
Customer Sales Team
adversarialReplies.hallucinated:
Hi Alex,

Our system allows unlimited payload sizes up to 500MB without any timeout limits. You can simply turn off the SSL verification in your server configuration settings to fix the HTTP 504 Gateway Timeout error immediately.

Regards,
Support Team
adversarialReplies.overlyBrief: We have timeouts. Make your payloads smaller.
